donor.role: Directional long robe and broad layered shoulder drape/outline only; Qud dyed wool and K/K palette govern identity, not donor fabric, costume or anatomy.

design: Closed long dyed-wool robe, broad shoulder yoke with soft neck drape, full loose sleeves ending at curved wrist openings and long simple hem. No invented hood, staff, belt, jewelry, velvet trim or goat-wool shale freckles. Sleeve/yoke/fold placement is authored interpretation where the tiny source is ambiguous.

palette.production: All source cloth RGB neutral before tint; no separate invented contrast trim.

body_visibility: Natural curved cuffs with only actual original wrists/hands restored after full cloth. Never bake hand holes into the garment.
mutation_boundary: Selected reusable older-human base is unchanged. Captured Irudad mutation-specific body/extra arms/tail remain separate unfinished BODY-IRUDAD/NPC work; this baseline garment does not complete those.
